The Age of Darkness

“The Age of Darkness” is a compelling contemporary play that delves deep into existential crises and socio-political turmoils. Set against a backdrop of a fracturing society where hope is scarce, the narrative follows interconnected individuals navigating a landscape stripped of moral certainty. Through powerful, evocative dialogue, experimental physical theater, and dramatic atmospheric design, the production raises urgent questions about survival, truth, and the endurance of the human spirit. It challenges the audience to seek out fragments of light within dark circumstances, making it a deeply resonant and timely artistic experience.
